consequence: Qwen3.8 is the CLOSEST of the three to the 50 TPS gate and it is closest on the honest axis: it is GPU-bound, so its wall clock is its GPU time plus ~0.5 ms, whereas Q80's 225 ms token hides 100 ms of host work behind a 125 ms GPU. For Qwen3.8 ONLY, reducing BPW buys TPS directly: it sits at 3.0x its DRAM floor, so a 2.0 BPW pack moves the floor from 14.414 ms to ~7.2 ms and the 3.0x ratio to ~21.6 ms/token - within reach of the 20 ms gate. For Q80 and DSV4F, density buys nothing until the host facets are removed.
